graph.name: Create, improve, summarize example
graph.description: A local-first headless DAG for external-evaluator workflows.

nodes.name: Gather current evidence
nodes.prompt: Use host-console tools for current evidence. If the tools are unavailable, block this step and list required data.

metadata.hostToolInstructions: Use available host-console tools. Do not rely on model memory for current facts.
metadata.expectedOutput: Evidence packet with citations, timestamps, and data gaps.

nodes.name: Improve analysis
nodes.prompt: Use the evidence packet to improve the current answer. Separate facts, assumptions, uncertainty, and open questions.

metadata.expectedOutput: Improved answer with cited facts, assumptions, uncertainty, and open questions.

nodes.name: Summarize delta
nodes.prompt: Summarize what changed, what remains blocked, and what should be checked next.

metadata.expectedOutput: Brief change summary with blocked items and next checks.

edges.condition: Use current evidence or explicit data gaps.
